# UI Design Editor

Source: https://uidesigneditor.com/

## 100% local editor

- All files stay in your browser

- No signup

- Free to use

- [Open source on GitHub](https://github.com/janpmz/uidesigneditor)

### Use with Codex

Copy prompt

Site tools need a supported Codex browser.

Use https://uidesigneditor.com/ as my design canvas. Use this page's WebMCP site tools through a supported Codex browser. Keep using the same open tab and its current project.

Start with read_design. For every change, use the latest projectId and revision returned by the tools. If the design changes while you work, read it again before retrying. Use the tools to make edits directly; keep my edits and the normal Undo history.

Use edit_design to add, move, resize, restyle or remove items. Use create_design for a full design in a new project. Keep text, shapes, icons and buttons as separate items I can edit. Use select_project to open a project listed by read_design.

For an attached screenshot, call import_image with its bytes as a base64 image data URL. Use mode "new" to open it at its own size, or "add" to place it in the current design. Use move_image_region to move part of a screenshot, and edit_design to add or change items over it.

For HTML saved by this editor, extract its initial-layout JSON and send import_html a small HTML document containing only that application/json script. For other HTML, rebuild its visible design as items with create_design or edit_design. Read the tools' input fields for the required values.

Check the result with read_design and a PNG from export_design. Refresh the site's tool list if the browser reports a stale tool. Use export_design to save the editable HTML. Tell me what changed. If site tools are unavailable, explain that a supported browser with site tools enabled is required.

---

# About

Move and resize text, shapes, icons and pictures in your browser.

Your work stays in this browser. The editor sends no project data to a server.

Player and Library start as local projects. Use **Projects** to switch between them. Each keeps its own edits.

Use **Copy HTML** to keep a file. Clearing browser data removes saved drafts.

Free to use. [View the code on GitHub](https://github.com/janpmz/uidesigneditor).

[Open editor](https://uidesigneditor.com/)
